instruction: A candid documentary photograph in a medium shot captures an indoor study room. On the left, the woman in the beige pantsuit (R2) stands in profile, smiling as she extends her right hand. On the right, the man in the blue turtleneck (R1) leans forward, rising from a seat to shake her hand. They clasp right hands over a wooden table in the foreground, which is decorated with a colorful Scrabble board and educational books. The man holds a smartphone in his left hand. Warm, soft indoor lighting illuminates the scene, creating a cozy atmosphere with natural colors.
